reason: The company is undergoing a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) and the voting results from the 8th Committee of Creditors meeting indicate a progression toward liquidation or a distressed restructuring that typically wipes out equity value.
why_now: The outcome of the 8th CoC meeting was filed with the exchange on October 4, 2026, marking a critical step in the insolvency timeline.
source_headlines: DPSC Limited: DPSC Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process-Outcome of the Voting Results of the 8th (Eighth) Meeting of the Committee of Creditors (CoC) of India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL)
